niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single “best” CTV advertising agency — the right partner depends on your goals, budget, target audience, geography, and whether you need programmatic scale, premium publisher access, creative production, or measurement/attribution expertise.

If you want a quick starting point, think in two categories:

1) Large holding-group media agencies (best for big brands and full-funnel campaigns)
- GroupM (Mindshare/Wavemaker/MediaCom), Omnicom (OMD/PHD), Publicis (Starcom/Spark Foundry), IPG (Initiative/UM), Dentsu (Carat)
- Pros: scale, access to premium inventory and data, integrated TV+digital planning, creative and analytics resources.
- Cons: higher cost, potentially less nimble.

2) CTV/OTT specialists and platforms (best for performance, streaming-first advertisers, or specific platform access)
- The Trade Desk (DSP) — industry-leading programmatic buying platform (often used by agencies).
- Roku Advertising (OneView/managed service) — great reach on Roku devices and strong streaming-audience targeting.
- Amobee — cross-screen planning and buying with TV-to-digital measurement.
- Simulmedia — specializes in planning/buying that bridges linear TV and CTV with outcome measurement.
- Innovid — strong creative, dynamic video, and measurement for CTV.
- Tremor Video / Magnite / SpotX — strong supply-side/CTV inventory partners and programmatic access.
- Amazon Ads / Samsung Ads — platform-specific solutions with first‑party data for Fire TV and Samsung TV owners.

How to choose the right agency (checklist)
- Campaign objective: brand awareness, reach, direct response, subscriptions, etc.
- Inventory access: premium streaming apps vs programmatic open exchange vs platform-specific (Roku/Hulu/Prime).
- Measurement & attribution: single-source measurement, offline conversion tracking, MMM, or incrementality testing?
- Creative capabilities: can they deliver CTV-optimized creative (longer form, interactive, dynamic)?
- Targeting & data: first‑party data integration, identity resolution, privacy compliance.
- Transparency & reporting: viewability, completion rates, fraud prevention, spend transparency.
- Platform expertise: experience with the platforms you care about (Roku, Hulu, YouTube/YouTubeTV, Amazon Fire TV, Samsung).
- Budget & fee model: hourly/retainer vs % of media vs performance fees.
- Case studies & references in your vertical.

If you tell me: (a) campaign goals, (b) monthly/media budget, (c) target geography and audience, and (d) whether you need creative or measurement help, I can recommend a 3–5 agency shortlist tailored to your needs and a set of RFP questions to vet them. Which details can you share?
